source: reconstruction of a GitLab project deploying from an unprotected default branch
note: Branch protection and settings variables of a third-party project cannot be read, so this reproduces the common shape: main is not protected (so the deploy credentials are left unprotected too, or the deploy would fail), and the deploy job runs kubectl apply on every push to main with the production environment. Anyone with push access to main runs the deploy job with the registry password: the unprotected push entry (anchored by the branch finding) into a job holding a secret and deploying is Critical. KUBE_CONFIG is a plain file variable (neither protected nor masked), configuration rather than a secret in the facts.
